Hero.bio: A QA Engineer specializing in Automation & AI Testing.

About.title: About Me
About.bio_1: I am a Quality Assurance Engineer with over 5 years of experience specializing in web, mobile, and API testing. My expertise lies in building robust automation testing frameworks using Cypress and Playwright, as well as exploring the cutting-edge of AI-driven quality management.
About.bio_2: With a strong foundation from 24+ certifications across leading platforms such as Microsoft, Google Cloud, Cisco, and Dicoding Academy, I continuously strive to implement best practices in software testing and development lifecycles.

jelajah-pintar.shortDesc: A smart navigation app using AI & Google Maps Platform to discover culinary spots and hidden gems along your travel route.
jelajah-pintar.longDesc: JelajahPintar is an innovative application that combines Artificial Intelligence (AI) with the Google Maps Platform to provide an efficient navigation experience for modern travelers. The system automatically scans the user's predetermined route, then suggests legendary culinary spots and tourist destinations (hidden gems) located right along the route without requiring the user to make U-turns (zero-detour).

lumina-aesthetic.shortDesc: An AI-powered web application for facial geometry analysis and 3D glasses simulation (AR Try-On) using Face-API and Gemini AI.
lumina-aesthetic.longDesc: LuminaAesthetic is an intelligent Optometric Design Suite that combines Computer Vision (Face-API) and Generative AI (Gemini Flash) for precise facial anatomy analysis. Key features include 68-point facial geometry detection, AR virtual glasses try-on simulation with auto-alignment, skin tone analysis, and optical medical report extraction into bilingual PDF format (ID/EN).

ml-cicd-pipeline.shortDesc: An end-to-end experimental project implementing Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) for California housing price prediction, complete with automated CI/CD pipeline.
ml-cicd-pipeline.longDesc: A comprehensive portfolio showcasing Data Science and MLOps expertise. This project is divided into two main pillars: first, designing a Python-based Machine Learning System (SML) to process the California Housing Prices dataset; second, implementing automated CI/CD Workflows using GitHub Actions that consistently test, validate, and deploy data pipelines efficiently with minimal bugs.

TC-001.name: Verify Homepage Load and Welcome Text
TC-001.description: Ensure the homepage loads correctly and the main H1 welcome text is visible.
TC-001.label: Positive
TC-001.expectedResult: The homepage renders successfully with the H1 heading clearly visible.
steps: Navigate to the English homepage ('/en').
Wait for the network state to be idle.
Locate the H1 heading containing the user's name.
Assert that the heading is visible on the screen.

TC-002.name: Verify Web Demo Navigation
TC-002.description: Verify that users can navigate from the homepage to the Web Demo page using the main navigation link.
TC-002.label: Positive
TC-002.expectedResult: User is successfully redirected to the Web Demo page and the correct heading is displayed.
steps: Navigate to the English homepage ('/en').
Locate the 'Web Demo' link in the navigation menu.
Click the 'Web Demo' link.
Wait for the URL to change to include '/web-demo'.
Verify the H1 heading 'Automation & CI/CD Showcase' is visible.

TC-003.name: Verify Localization Switcher
TC-003.description: Ensure that changing the language from English to Indonesian correctly updates the text content on the page.
TC-003.label: Positive
TC-003.expectedResult: The website successfully changes the locale and translates the target text to Indonesian.
steps: Navigate to the English homepage ('/en').
Verify initial English text ('Available for new opportunities').
Locate and click the localization dropdown/button.
Select 'Indonesia (ID)' from the options.
Wait for navigation and network state to be idle.
Verify the URL contains '/id'.
Assert that the text has updated to Indonesian ('Terbuka untuk peluang baru').

TC-004.name: Negative Test: Verify 404 on Invalid Route
TC-004.description: Ensure that navigating to a non-existent route correctly renders a 404 error page instead of crashing.
TC-004.label: Negative
TC-004.expectedResult: The server returns a 404 HTTP status and the Next.js default 404 page is rendered to the user.
steps: Attempt to navigate to the non-existent URL.
Capture the HTTP response status code.
Assert that the HTTP response status is exactly 404.
Locate the H2 heading on the page.
Assert the heading contains the text 'This page could not be found'.

TC-005.name: Edge Test: Verify Mobile Navigation Menu
TC-005.description: Verify that the responsive mobile hamburger menu appears and functions correctly on small screens.
TC-005.label: Edge
TC-005.expectedResult: The mobile menu button is present on small screens, and clicking it successfully reveals the hidden navigation links.
steps: Set the browser viewport size to mobile dimensions (375x812).
Navigate to the homepage.
Locate the hamburger menu button (visible only on mobile).
Assert that the hamburger menu button is visible.
Click the menu button to expand the navigation.
Verify that the 'About' link becomes visible in the expanded menu.
